summary.text: Son of Polyaemon whom peerless Teucer laid on the bounteous earth with his mighty bow — the seventh named in the eight warriors Ajax screened while Teucer harried the Trojan battalions.

story.text: After Daetor, Chromius, and godlike Lycophontes, Teucer smote Amopaon, Polyaemon's son, and then Melanippus, one after another, to the bounteous earth while Agamemnon waxed glad at the archer's havoc.
